verdict.rationale: Cline's own docs show natural-language troubleshooting. You can converse with it about your codebase, give fix commands such as "run tests and fix failures" or "fix the layout issue shown in @./screenshot.png", and it reacts to live terminal output and makes linter-aware fixes. However, there is no dedicated debugging feature documented, and the troubleshooting depth is only implied by examples. Missing for 10: documented debugging workflow (e.g., stack-trace/log analysis, breakpoint or debugger integration), detailed docs on diagnosing root causes beyond fix commands, and independent hands-on corroboration of debugging quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries
